messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 36(2)

Article 36 Changes to notifications. 2. In the event of restriction, suspension or withdrawal of notification, or where the notified body has ceased its activity, the notifying authority shall take appropriate steps to ensure that the files of that body are either processed by another notified body or kept available for the responsible notifying and market surveillance authorities at their request.

response.text:
notifying authority | shallTakeSteps | ensure the files of the notified body are processed by another notified body or kept available | in the event of restriction, suspension or withdrawal of notification, or where the notified body has ceased its activity | "the notifying authority shall take appropriate steps to ensure that the files of that body are either processed by another notified body or kept available"

files of the notified body | processedBy | another notified body | in the event of restriction, suspension or withdrawal of notification, or where the notified body has ceased its activity | "either processed by another notified body"

files of the notified body | keptAvailableFor | responsible notifying and market surveillance authorities | at their request | "kept available for the responsible notifying and market surveillance authorities at their request"
